name: Demon, Abyssal Drone
body:
Demon, Abyssal Drone CR 3

XP 800
CE Medium outsider (chaotic, demon, evil, extraplanar)
Init +6; Senses darkvision 60 ft.; Perception +4

DEFENSE

AC 17, touch 12, flat-footed 15 (+2 Dex, +5 natural)
hp 30 (5d10+5); fast healing 1
Fort +1, Ref +5, Will +1
DR 5/cold iron or good; Immune electricity, poison; Resist acid 10, cold 10, fire 10

OFFENSE

Speed 20 ft.
Melee longsword +7 (1d8+4)
Space 10 ft.; Reach 10 ft.

STATISTICS

Str 18; Dex 14; Con 11; Int 5,Wis 12; Cha 11
Base Atk +3; CMB +0; CMD 12
Feats Improved Initiative, Improved Natural Armor
Skills Perception +4, Stealth +2
Languages Abyssal

ECOLOGY

Environment any (Abyss)
Organization solitary or horde (2–50)
Treasure standard (longsword)

Spawned forth from malignant mortals who do evil in the name of Chaos, the demonic abyssal drone fill the rank and file of the soldiers of the Abyss.

The abyssal drones are considered almost vermin within the Abyss, and will aimlessly murder any non-demonic being that crosses their path unless ordered otherwise. Abyssal drones, unlike many other demons, will obey stronger demonic entities, and are used to exterminate infestations of qlippoth that occur within the Abyss. The abyssal drones also serve as shock troops for when Abyssal forces are needed.

Abyssal drones are 7 feet tall, and weigh 300 pounds. They exhibit highly chaotic tendencies, and will do battle with demons, devils, qlippoth, mortal beings, or each other when idle for too long.
